intro.text: A Veden noblewoman, the daughter of Highprince Valam.

items.text: Lin Davar suggested his son Balat marry Sudi, hoping to gain influence for his house. Balat pointed out that she was in her fifties and recently widowed by a duel, and that Valam would never approve. He protested so fiercely that he nearly came to blows with his father, being in love with Eylita Tavinar.
After the Veden civil war, the dying King Valam called Redin his only living child, so Sudi had apparently died by then.
